projects.name: Accurate Block Placement
projects.summary: Hold right click with a block and every new spot you look at gets one, however fast you move.
projects.description:
Placing blocks fast is all about timing: vanilla places a block every four ticks while you hold right click, so moving fast skips spots and moving slowly stacks extra blocks. **Accurate Block Placement** times it for you: hold right click and every *new* spot you look at gets a block at once.

- **A new spot, a block**: bridging, building walls and floors, or sweeping along a row; no spot skipped,

projects.name: Compass Enhanced
projects.summary: A compass bar with degrees and colored directions, plus death points that guide you back.
projects.description:
A compass bar at the top of your screen that shows where you are facing, in degrees, and slides smoothly as you turn.

## Features
- Compass letters (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) in a color you choose
- Death points: every time you die, a marker stays on the bar with the distance to where you died
- Reaching a death point turns it into an X with a countdown, or look at it and press X to dismiss it

versions.changelog:
First release.

- Compass bar with degrees and compass letters (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
- Death points with distance, arrival countdown and a key to dismiss them (X by default)
- Settings: bar on/off, background, scale, letter color, arrival distance, X time and death points kept

projects.name: Daybreak
projects.summary: Sun shadows, reflective water, waving plants, coloured light, sun rays and bloom, built to cost as little GPU time as possible.
projects.description:
Daybreak is a shader pack in Horizon's own format. It runs inside Horizon's renderer, so Horizon's culling, batching and LOD stay in charge, and it adds as little GPU time as it can.

- Sun and moon shadows with smooth edges
- Warm sunlight, blue sky light in the shade, a dim blue night
- Coloured block light: soul fire blue, redstone red, copper green, froglights
- Light from torches in your hand

versions.changelog: First release: sun and moon shadows, warm sunlight and blue shade, coloured block light, waving plants, reflective water with waves, a deeper sky, sun rays, sun glare, haze, bloom and a colour grade. The High preset (soft shadows over 96 blocks, water reflections). Needs a Horizon build from 2026-11-03 or newer (Nightly 2944480 and later). Release v0.1.1 of the repository.

projects.name: Menu Panorama
projects.summary: Put your own wallpaper behind the main menu in Horizon — Minecraft 26.3, rewritten in Rust.
projects.description:
Menu Panorama is a resource pack for **Horizon** — Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, rewritten from scratch in **Rust**.

It replaces the six textures of the main-menu background with a picture you choose. It is a plain resource pack, not a Java mod: no mod loader, no Java, and no code from the pack is executed. Horizon loads it natively.

- **Any photo** in the `room` mode: the picture is shown whole

versions.changelog:
First release.

- Demo sunset pack: six 1024×1024 faces and a 128×128 icon.
- `panorama-maker.html`: browser generator with drag & drop, auto/room/360 modes and 512/1024/2048 face sizes.
- `make_panorama.py`: CLI with the same modes, preview output and `--description`.
- `pack.mcmeta` for Horizon 26.3: resource format 97, `pack_format` 34, formats 15–999.
- MIT licence.
